questions_before_times: What is the problem? (a crack, a bowing wall, a sloping floor, water coming in)
Where in the home, and about how long is it
When did you first see it, and has it changed
The year the home was built, and the kind of foundation if you know it
safety_stop: gas smell, hissing near a gas line, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
a wall or floor giving way right now, a loud crack with movement, a ceiling sagging or falling
